regions.merged_text: God bless you and yours. Many thanks for your kind favor of just noted. We are enrolling your little Maureen in the Seraphic Mass Associa- tion that if it be God's holy will she may give the doctors and all who may be interested in her case, a good surprise. At the same time I would suggest that you get as many of your friends as possible to help you storm Heaven by frequent and daily Communion. And I might add, that you promise the Poor Souls - especially your own family- relatives, there doing penance and always interested in the welfare of their dear ones there left behind, that you will do somthing special for them if join the rest of friends as well as they may, by their pleading the cause of little Maureen as best they can. I've seen wonderful results and have had astonishing reports as throuth enrolling the Poor Souls, e.g., for a given percentage of the a- verted "doctor-bills". Thanks be to the merciful condesntion of Almighty God - and the all surpassing intercession of our B1. Mother Mary
